reason: Keeping my application history on my own machine is appealing, and the features cover the scattered tracking I do now. I would try it once, but Docker setup could make me quit before I get to the useful parts.
objection: I need to know exactly what information AI sees and whether it can stick to my real projects instead of making up claims.
would_change_my_mind: A quick demo mode plus a clear explanation of which data stays local and which data goes to an optional AI provider.
